skill.name: airbnb-listing-price-and-location-finder
skill.description: Search Airbnb by location and stay dates for listing price, rating, Superhost and verification status, GPS coordinates, and photos per property. Output fields: name, nightlyPrice, totalPrice, rating, reviewCount and more, as JSON rows. Use it for requests like "Airbnb price scraper", "short-term rental comps", "Airbnb listings by city", or a CSV/JSON export of public Airbnb data.
skill.summary: Retrieve public Airbnb listing prices and locations through an Apify Actor using stay dates, guest counts, and search filters.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 66 static findings are false positives involving documentation syntax, JavaScript strings, intended file reads, and authenticated Apify requests. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized credential disclosure, or destructive behavior in the reviewed files. The external Actor implementation was not included; execution sends search inputs to Apify and can incur account charges.

content.user_title: Find Airbnb Listing Prices and Locations
content.value_statement: Comparing Airbnb stays requires consistent dates, guest counts, and pricing details. This skill submits filtered searches to an Apify Actor and retrieves structured listing results.
actual_capabilities: Submit location, neighborhood, place ID, or map-bound searches through the documented Apify Actor.
Request details for specific Airbnb listing URLs or listing IDs.
Configure stay dates, guest counts, currency, price limits, room type, and property filters.
Retrieve JSON dataset rows with declared fields for prices, ratings, locations, listing URLs, and host indicators.
Request optional listing details, reviews, photos, and availability calendars through documented Actor inputs.
Run synchronous requests with the Node runner or use the documented asynchronous API workflow for larger jobs.
limitations: Requires an Apify token, network access, and billable Actor usage; the supplied Node runner requires Node 18 or later.
The external Actor implementation is not included, and live data accuracy or field completeness was not verified during this audit.
Only public data is supported; private, login-protected, and paywalled data are outside the documented scope.
Prices and availability can change; synchronous runs can exceed the documented 300-second wait, and the runner outputs JSON rather than CSV.

use_cases.title: Compare Candidate Stays
use_cases.description: Compare public listing prices, room types, ratings, and locations for the same dates and guest count.

use_cases.title: Research Comparable Rental Prices
use_cases.description: Collect a limited sample of comparable public listings using consistent property filters, currency, and stay dates.

use_cases.title: Collect Geographic Listing Samples
use_cases.description: Request listings within a map area and use returned coordinates and listing identifiers for a research dataset.

prompt_templates.title: Search a City
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 10 public Airbnb listings in [city] for [check-in] through [check-out], for two adults. Confirm Apify costs before running.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: run a small location search.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Comparable Stays
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [neighborhood] in [city] for [dates]. Use two adults, USD, entire homes, and a [maximum] nightly price. Limit results to 20.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare listings using consistent filters.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Selected Listings
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve details for these public Airbnb URLs: [URLs]. Use [dates], enable details and reviews, and return up to six reviews per listing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: enrich a selected listing sample.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Map-Based Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a search for [bounding box] using [dates], [guests], and [currency]. Cap results at 100. Request cost approval before asynchronous execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a bounded geographic data collection job.

output_examples.input: Find Miami stays for two adults from December 1 through December 3, 2026, with a limit of 20 listings.
output: Illustrative result summary, not a live search.
Listing A: entire apartment in Miami; nightly price USD 150; stay total USD 360; rating 4.8 from 120 reviews.
Confirm fee inclusion and current availability before booking.

output_examples.input: Retrieve details and six recent reviews for a selected public Airbnb listing.
output: Illustrative detail summary, not a live result.
Listing B: private room; Superhost indicator present; Wi-Fi listed; photo references returned; six reviews available.
No stay quote requested because check-in and check-out dates were not supplied.

best_practices: Start with a small maxListings value and review current Actor pricing before approving a run.
Use identical stay dates, guest counts, and currency when comparing prices; check fee indicators and missing fields.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN outside prompts and input files; use only public listing data and review applicable terms and laws.
anti_patterns: Do not supply cookies, account sessions, credentials, or private account data as Actor inputs.
Do not treat retrieved prices, coordinates, or availability as guaranteed booking facts.
Do not enable large runs or costly enrichment options without reviewing account charges and collection limits.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account token and network access. The included Node runner requires Node 18 or later.

faq.question: Is the service free?
faq.answer: Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Review the Actor Pricing tab before running; enrichment options can require additional requests.

faq.question: Can I search a specific map area?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented bbox input accepts southwest and northeast coordinates, with an optional zoom value.

faq.question: Can I retrieve details for known listings?
faq.answer: Yes. Details mode accepts listing URLs or IDs. Optional inputs request reviews, availability calendars, and other enrichment.

faq.question: Does the included runner export CSV?
faq.answer: No. The runner prints JSON dataset rows. CSV conversion requires a separate export or processing step.

faq.question: Can this skill access private listings or guarantee prices?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is public data only. Prices, availability, and returned fields depend on the external Actor and current Airbnb results.
